usage: Feat choice for chargen or level-up.

srd.text: _General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+)_ Increase Strength or Dexterity by 1. When you Dash, your Speed increases by 10 feet for that move. If you move at least 10 feet straight toward a target and hit it with a melee attack, add 1d8 damage or push it 10 feet.
